test_jwt_authenticate_valid_token: test the authenticate function with a valid JWT token and matching token version
test_jwt_authenticate_expired_token: test the authenticate function rejects an expired JWT token with a 401 response
test_csrf_protection_post_put_delete: test that POST, PUT, DELETE requests require a valid CSRF token and return 403 on mismatch
test_owner_filter_injects_user_id: test the add_owner_filter function injects the authenticated user identity into request metadata
test_token_version_mismatch_revoked: test that a JWT with a stale token version is rejected as revoked with 401
